name: Bitly
jobs: short links on a custom domain
verdict_reason: $10/mo for a URL redirect table is the purest markup on this site. Shlink does the whole job list from SQLite on the smallest box you own.
what_you_lose: The bit.ly domain itself — recognizable short links are their real moat; yours is only as trusted as your domain
Their uptime SLA: a dead redirect server breaks every link you ever shared

what_broke: Boot to healthy: 12s (improved from 20s) — shlink v5.1.6 pulled cleanly.
DEFAULT_DOMAIN commitment unchanged: set it before creating links, changing it later orphans old short URLs.
